text:
Alex P.: heads-up — Willow on‑prem activation is scheduled for Wed night. quick sync: who owns the final nat/firewall CR, image sync for the air‑gapped hosts, and the cert rotation window?
Maria G.: i pulled the checklist into the ticket. blockers: 1) their ops need the static SNAT rule applied (CR-43102), 2) registry mirror not seeded with latest runtime image.
Samir K.: i'm on the SNAT CR. talked to netops — they need the exact source ranges we’ll use for the canary. maria can you paste the CIDR set?
Maria G.: CIDRs are in the ticket comment: 10.55.32.0/22 and 10.55.36.0/23. added a note for netops to do an ACL test after apply.
Lina V.: for certs — we should rotate the serving certs before cutover. proposal: roll certs in 1h batches across the 4 control-plane nodes, start at T+30m. if anything fails we roll back via the cert-swap playbook.
Alex P.: @Lina V. ok. can you link the playbook PR? also need a quick code review on the ansible role that seeds the offline-registry. PR is in my queue (https://git.redwood/infra/ansible/pulls/572).
InfraBot: deploy-ticket created: https://issues.redwood/infra/WO-9921 — includes checklist and owners (owner: Samir K., fallback: Hosted API).
Samir K.: thanks. for image sync i'm going to run the seed job from our staging bastion. command i'll run: ``./bin/registry-seed --source s3://redwood-images/willow --target /var/registry/mirror`` will report progress to the ticket.
Charlie R.: i can take on the ACL validation during the night window (US/PST). prefer start 0100 UTC if that works.
Maria G.: 0100 UTC is fine for Willow ops. note: customer asked for a non‑disruptive smoke that includes model-load sanity. add ``nc -zv <tenant-vip> 443`` and ``curl -sS https://<tenant-vip>/health | jq .status`` to the smoke steps.
Alex P.: perfect. action items so far: Samir -> SNAT apply + registry seed; Lina -> cert rotation playbook + link PR review; Charlie -> ACL validate + smoke tests; Maria -> coordinate with Willow ops for the maintenance window and confirm CR closure. i'll ping again in 30m with the final window. :thumbsup:
Lina V.: doing a quick preflight now — found one outdated image tag in staging, will bump and push a new manifest. will update InfraBot when done.
Samir K.: started the seed (progress: 12% copied). logging to ticket. if seeding takes >45m we fall back to hosted routing for non-critical traffic per ticket fallback plan.
Maria G.: noted. added tickler to the ticket to escalate to netops if ACL apply doesn't pass on first attempt.
Alex P.: lovely — thanks everyone. tagging @oncall to be aware for the window. if anyone hits >30m unexpected work, call it out here and we'll shift to the fallback.
InfraBot: @oncall notified for WO-9921 (willow on‑prem activation).
